propositions: Reconciler core currently reaches into Jira adapter directly with no named interface for alternate backends to implement

Backend facade must define five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) with RemoteRef identity type
JiraBackend thin wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules with zero behavior change and no core call site rewiring
Backend capability detection must use isinstance() checks against @runtime_checkable Protocols rather than a capabilities() method or structural introspection

Contract suite must pass against both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend (test-only), validating round-trip field mapping, sanitizer idempotency, and capability-guarded dispatch
Characterization tests must assert pure Jira mapper outputs are byte-for-byte identical to pre-story main behavior for representative fixtures
